$comment: VAPP-260 (Engine E0, epic VAPP-259, docs/spec/apps.md §13.1): WHAT A HOST HANDS THE ENGINE, the `HostConfig`. Each key of `providers` is `required` (the Engine refuses to start without it: `missing`) or optional (absent = its `default`); `list: true` = zero or more. There is NO telemetry and NO update provider: `forbidden` keys are refused by name (`forbidden`), so an exported runner can never grow an analytics, crash-report or over-the-air channel through its config (a new package version = a rebundle, decided 2026-11-05); any other unknown key is `unknown`. `network` is one of `networkPolicies`; `identity.kind` one of `identityKinds`. A capability is mounted under its name (capabilities.json), each name once (`duplicateCapability`); an agent provider (Agents' `AgentProvider`: `acp`, `localModel`, `remoteSession`) once per id (`duplicateAgent`). `validateHostConfig(config)` -> the issues `{key, code}` in `providers` order, then forbidden and unknown keys sorted. HOSTS (`hosts`): what each host kind provides, informative and checked against the validator (each must pass). IDENTITY (`identityCases`, `engineViewer`): `member` = the signed-in member with their team role and app access (Exponential); `local` = ONE person on one device and no account (the softcoded app, eDE Local desktops, exported apps): the viewer = `{id: the device uuid, role: owner, access: write}`, so genUI's `recordRefusal` allows every op of every kind policy (`member`, `author`, `owners` all collapse to "me"), and records the instance writes carry the device uuid as author; `peer` = a P2P key (Spezl), judged like `member` with the key as id and role `member`. NETWORK (`networkCases`, `networkAllows`): `off` = nothing leaves the device (upstreams, `http.fetch` and a sync transport are refused `offline`); `upstreamsOnly` = the package's declared `upstreams` and the sync transport, never `http.fetch`; `any` = all three (an `http.fetch` still needs its manifest origin and consent: capabilities.json). A refusal is `{allowed: false, reason}`.

host.doc: HostInfo: host kind, platform, form factor, locale, Engine version

storage.doc: RecordStore: query, write (writeId), history, subscribe (MemoryRecordStore, SqliteRecordStore = elocal's app-records table, SyncedRecordStore)

blobs.doc: BlobStore: put/get record files (FsBlobStore, the server's attachments)

identity.doc: Identity: the viewer (member, local or peer)

vault.doc: emcp Vault: grants, upstream tokens (Keychain, Keystore, libsecret, sealed server column)

window.doc: WindowHost: open a screen (window, nav stack, sheet), report lifecycle events

zone.doc: HostZone: the IANA zone of today/now/month (the team's in Exponential)

sync.doc: SyncTransport: pull deltas, push outbox entries (Exponential: Electric in, tRPC out; Spezl: P2P); absent = writes apply locally, no outbox

agents.doc: AgentProvider (Agents): acp, localModel, remoteSession; each gets its tools only as a hub grant

capabilities.doc: Capability: a native tool provider on the in-process hub (capabilities.json)

consent.doc: ConsentUi: the Engine's own genUI sheet unless the host paints it (consent.json)

a capability under a reserved or invalid name
